item.title: Sault MP Terry Sheehan shares condolences with Timbler Ridge

item.title: Man steals suitcase, sticks from vehicles in Sault's downtown
item.description: A suitcase, two hockey sticks and $500 worth of office supplies were among items taken when a man smashed the windows of several vehicles downtown. The incidents happened between July 2024 and October 2025, Ontario Court Justice John Condon heard Thursday. Clinton Perrault pleaded guilty to 10 charges including three counts each mischief and theft […]

item.title: Pancakes served in Iron Bridge
item.description: A pancake supper will be hosted by Iron Bridge United Church on Tuesday. Hours are 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. at 22147 Highway 17, a release says. Entry is by donation.

item.title: Watch parties in Thessalon cheer on Rousseau
item.description: Watch parties are planned as biathlete Shilo Rousseau competes at the 2026 Winter Olympics.
